
---
title: "Multi-omics data processing and analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

This notebook processes transcriptomics, metabolomics, and proteomics data for cross-omics analysis.

## 1. Transcriptomics

### DESeq2 normalization, VST, and differential expression

Load raw counts and sample metadata, filter low-expression genes, fit the DESeq2 model, and export VST values and the PRIMING-versus-CONTROL results.

```{r transcriptomics-deseq2}

library(DESeq2)
library(edgeR)

# Read CSV
df <- read.csv(
  "transcriptomics.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Identify sample columns
sample_cols <- 1:(ncol(df) - 2)

# Extract metadata
metadata <- data.frame(
  SAMPLE = colnames(df)[sample_cols],
  TREATMENT = as.character(unlist(df[1, sample_cols])),
  TIME = paste0(unlist(df[2, sample_cols]), "d"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Set factors and reference levels
metadata$TREATMENT <- factor(
  metadata$TREATMENT,
  levels = c("CONTROL", "PRIMING")
)

metadata$TIME <- factor(
  metadata$TIME,
  levels = c("1d", "2d", "3d", "4d")
)

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$SAMPLE

# Extract expression matrix
expression_matrix <- as.matrix(
  data.frame(df[5:nrow(df), sample_cols], check.names = FALSE)
)

rownames(expression_matrix) <- make.unique(
  as.character(df$AGI[5:nrow(df)])
)

storage.mode(expression_matrix) <- "numeric"

# Check that values are valid raw counts
stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(expression_matrix)),
  all(expression_matrix >= 0),
  all(expression_matrix == round(expression_matrix))
)

# Ensure metadata and expression matrix are aligned
metadata <- metadata[colnames(expression_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(metadata), colnames(expression_matrix))
)

# Filter lowly expressed genes
design_matrix <- model.matrix(
  ~ TIME + TREATMENT,
  data = metadata
)

keep <- filterByExpr(
  expression_matrix,
  design = design_matrix
)

counts_filtered <- expression_matrix[keep, , drop = FALSE]

# Create DESeq2 dataset
dds_general <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts_filtered),
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ TIME + TREATMENT
)

# Estimate library size normalization factors and fit model
dds_general <- DESeq(dds_general)

# Inspect size factors
sizeFactors(dds_general)

# Variance stabilizing transformation (VST)
vsd <- vst(dds_general, blind = FALSE)

# Extract VST-transformed expression matrix
vst_matrix <- assay(vsd)

# Convert to dataframe and include gene identifiers
vst_df <- as.data.frame(vst_matrix)
vst_df$AGI <- rownames(vst_df)

# Place gene identifiers in the first column
vst_df <- vst_df[, c("AGI", colnames(vst_matrix))]

# Save VST-transformed data
write.csv(
  vst_df,
  "lod-pathways-community/pilots/pairedomics_overlap/arabidopsis_heat_stress/data/transcriptomics_deseqnorm+VST.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Extract overall PRIMING vs CONTROL comparison
results_general <- results(
  dds_general,
  contrast = c("TREATMENT", "PRIMING", "CONTROL")
)

# Convert results to dataframe
results_general_df <- as.data.frame(results_general)

results_general_df$AGI <- rownames(results_general_df)

# Save results
write.csv(
  results_general_df,
  "lod-pathways-community/pilots/pairedomics_overlap/arabidopsis_heat_stress/data/DESeq2_PRIMING_vs_CONTROL_general.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## 2. Metabolomics

### Load metabolomics measurements

Read metabolomics data and extract sample metadata and the abundance matrix.

```{r metabolomics-import}
df_m <- read.csv("metabolomics.csv",
               header = TRUE,
               check.names = FALSE,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# Identify sample columns (exclude gene_id and AGI)
sample_cols <- 2:(ncol(df_m))

# Extract metadata from the first four rows
m_metadata <- data.frame(
  SAMPLE = colnames(df_m)[sample_cols],
  TREATMENT = as.character(unlist(df_m[1, sample_cols])),
  TIME = paste0(unlist(df_m[2, sample_cols]), "d"),
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)

# Ignore the fourth metadata row

# Extract expression matrix (rows 5 onwards)
metabolite_matrix <- as.matrix(
  data.frame(df_m[5:nrow(df_m), sample_cols], check.names = FALSE)
)

# Set AGI (last column) as row names
rownames(metabolite_matrix) <- df_m$AGI[5:nrow(df_m)]

# Ensure expression values are numeric
storage.mode(metabolite_matrix) <- "numeric"

```

### Log transformation

Calculate log2-transformed metabolite abundances.

```{r metabolomics-log2}
metabolite_log <- log2(metabolite_matrix)
```

### Export metabolomics matrix

Export the metabolomics matrix.

```{r metabolomics-export}
write.csv(metabolite_matrix,"lod-pathways-community/pilots/pairedomics_overlap/arabidopsis_heat_stress/data/metabolomics_log.csv")
```

## 3. Proteomics

### Load proteomics measurements

Read protein abundances and inspect missing or zero-valued observations.

```{r proteomics-import}
# PROTEOMICS
# Read proteomics data
prot <- read.csv(
  "proteomics.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Keep protein annotations separately
protein_info <- prot[, c("Accession", "Description")]

# Extract sample columns (exclude Accession and Description)
sample_cols <- names(prot)[-(1:2)]

# Create numeric protein abundance matrix
prot_matrix <- as.matrix(
  data.frame(lapply(prot[, sample_cols], as.numeric),
             check.names = FALSE)
)

# Set protein identifiers as row names
rownames(prot_matrix) <- make.unique(as.character(prot$Accession))

# Check missing values and zeros
sum(is.na(prot_matrix))
sum(prot_matrix == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
```

### Missing-value handling and transformation

Treat zero abundances as missing, filter proteins, and apply log2 transformation.

```{r proteomics-filter-log2}
# Treat zero as missing (only if zero means not detected)
prot_matrix[prot_matrix == 0] <- NA

# Remove proteins with NA in more than 28 samples
keep <- rowSums(is.na(prot_matrix)) <= 20

prot_matrix <- prot_matrix[keep, , drop = FALSE]


# Log2 transformation
prot_log <- log2(prot_matrix)
```

### Median normalization

Normalize the log-transformed protein abundances by sample medians.

```{r proteomics-median-normalization}
# Median normalization across samples
sample_medians <- apply(
  prot_log,
  2,
  median,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

grand_median <- median(sample_medians, na.rm = TRUE)

prot_normalized <- sweep(
  prot_log,
  2,
  sample_medians,
  FUN = "-"
)

prot_normalized <- prot_normalized + grand_median
```

### Export normalized protein abundances

Save the normalized proteomics matrix.

```{r proteomics-export-normalized}
write.csv(prot_normalized, "lod-pathways-community/pilots/pairedomics_overlap/arabidopsis_heat_stress/data/proteomics_mediannorm+log.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

### Differential abundance analysis with limma

Construct sample metadata, fit the limma model, and extract the PRIMING-versus-CONTROL comparison.

```{r proteomics-limma}
metadata_prot <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(prot_normalized),
  TREATMENT = ifelse(
    grepl("priming", colnames(prot_normalized), ignore.case = TRUE),
    "PRIMING",
    "CONTROL"
  ),
  TIME = sub("^.*?(\\d+)d_.*$", "\\1", colnames(prot_normalized)),
  REPLICATE = sub("^.*_(\\d+)$", "\\1", colnames(prot_normalized))
)

metadata_prot$TIME <- factor(metadata_prot$TIME,
                             levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"))

metadata_prot$TREATMENT <- factor(
  metadata_prot$TREATMENT,
  levels = c("CONTROL", "PRIMING")
)

rownames(metadata_prot) <- metadata_prot$Sample

library(limma)

# Set reference levels
metadata_prot$TIME <- factor(
  metadata_prot$TIME,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4")
)

metadata_prot$TREATMENT <- factor(
  metadata_prot$TREATMENT,
  levels = c("CONTROL", "PRIMING")
)

# Design matrix without interaction
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ TIME + TREATMENT,
  data = metadata_prot
)

# Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(prot_normalized, design)

# Empirical Bayes moderation
fit <- eBayes(fit)

# Overall PRIMING vs CONTROL
results_general <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef = "TREATMENTPRIMING",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH"
)

# Save results
results_general$Accession <- rownames(results_general)
```

### Export limma results

Save the proteomics differential-abundance results.

```{r proteomics-export-limma}
write.csv(results_general, "lod-pathways-community/pilots/pairedomics_overlap/arabidopsis_heat_stress/data/limma_proteomics.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
